recycleBin.title: Recycle bin
recycleBin.empty: Deleted documents wait here until they are restored or disposed of.
recycleBin.description: Deleted documents wait here. A records officer can restore them until they are disposed of.

records.title: Records
records.name: Name
records.description: Keep documents as long as the law and the bank require, hold them when a case needs them, and destroy them under two officers’ control.
records.holdByCifHint: Optional. Every document of this customer you may see is held.
records.noHoldsText: Place a hold when a case or an investigation needs documents kept as they are.
records.releaseText_one: {{total}} document becomes subject to its retention again and may be destroyed. This cannot be undone.
records.releaseText_other: {{total}} documents become subject to their retention again and may be destroyed. This cannot be undone.
records.policyProposed: Proposed; it applies once another officer approves it
records.eventTypeHint: The event a bank system reports, e.g. ACCOUNT_CLOSED.
records.requiresApprovalHint: Due documents go into a batch that a second records officer approves.
records.noPoliciesText: Without a policy, no document ever becomes due for disposal.

actionsApproved.DESTROY: Destroy, after a second officer approves
actionsApproved.REVIEW: Review, after a second officer approves

records.destroyed: The batch was approved and its documents destroyed
records.step1: Documents become due when their retention period ends and nothing holds them.
records.step2: One officer lists the documents due into a batch.
records.step3: A second officer approves it and the content is destroyed; a record that each document existed is kept.
records.noBatchesText: List the documents due to prepare one.
records.destroyText: Their content is destroyed for good; only a record that they existed is kept. This cannot be undone.
records.typeCount: Type {{count}} to confirm the number of documents

admin.title: Administration
admin.subject: Subject
admin.proposed: Proposed; another administrator must approve it
admin.noPendingChangesText: Proposals from other administrators appear here for you to approve or reject.
admin.pendingDescription: Changes to types, access rules and retention, waiting for a second administrator.
admin.proposeNote: Nothing changes until a second administrator approves the proposal.
admin.typeNotFound: No document type with this code
admin.typesDescription: Each type decides its fields, classification and approval. Every change needs a second administrator.
admin.name: Name
admin.label: Label
admin.arabicOptional: Optional. Arabic screens show the English name where this is empty.
admin.languagesDescription: The languages your staff can switch between. English is always on. A change needs a second administrator.
admin.languageArabicNote: Adds the English / Arabic switch to the screens, right-to-left layout, and Arabic names for document types, fields and list values. Arabic names stay optional.
admin.languagesUnchanged: Turn Arabic on or off to propose a change.
admin.languagesPending: A change to the languages is waiting for a second administrator.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: Every action and every refused attempt, chained so nobody can alter the history.
audit.intactText: All {{total}} events verified on {{at}}. No gaps or altered entries.

notifications.empty: Nothing new. Messages about your documents appear here.

types.VERSION_QUARANTINED: Your uploaded file failed the antivirus scan and was quarantined.

missing.REJECT: Write why you are rejecting it, then choose Reject again.
missing.RETURN: Write what the maker should change, then choose Return for changes again.

access.description: Who may do what across the bank. Branch and clearance are checked on top of these. Changes need a second security administrator.
access.caption: What each role may do across the bank
access.noRule: No rule grants this; the action is not allowed.
access.narrowerNote: Rules for one cabinet, type, folder or document, or for one user. A Deny here always wins.
access.proposed: Proposed; another security administrator must approve it
access.idHint: Paste the ID from the address of its page.
access.folderHint: The rule also covers its sub-folders.

committees.title: Committees
committees.description: Who votes on documents with the Committee approval route, and how many approvals decide. Every change needs a second tenant administrator.
committees.routed: Document types with the Committee approval route
committees.notRouted: Not used by the approval routes yet: only CREDIT_COMMITTEE is
committees.noneHint: Create CREDIT_COMMITTEE before giving any document type the Committee approval route.
committees.cannotVoteHint: This user has neither the Committee member nor the Checker role, so they cannot vote.
committees.votingNote: The maker of an item never votes on it. An item is approved when the approvals reach the quorum, and rejected when the quorum can no longer be reached.
committees.codeHint: Approval routes use the committee with the code {{code}}.
committees.name: Name
committees.quorumHint: From 1 to the number of members ({{count}}).

users.title: Users
users.description: Each user’s roles, branches and clearance. Roles come from Keycloak; branch and clearance changes need a second security administrator.
users.filter: Filter by name, role or branch
users.selfNote: You cannot change your own branches or clearance.
users.rolesNote: Roles are given in Keycloak and shown as at the user’s last sign-in.
users.clearanceHint: The most sensitive classification the user may see.
users.approvalNote: Nothing changes until a second security administrator approves the proposal under Pending changes.
users.proposed: Proposed; another security administrator must approve it

folders.title: Folders
folders.description: The folder tree of each cabinet, where documents are filed and folder access rules apply. Every change needs a second tenant administrator.
folders.noneHint: Documents can be filed in the cabinet without a folder. Create folders to organise them.
folders.pathHint: Bank systems can file into this folder by its path (folderPath in the integration API).
folders.deleteHint: Only an empty folder can be deleted: no sub-folders and no documents.
folders.name: Name
folders.parentHint: Leave empty for a top-level folder.
folders.approvalNote: Nothing changes until a second tenant administrator approves the proposal under Pending changes.
